scope: Server-owned Markdown snapshots for the supervised services pilot
changes: Save completed pilot reports in the existing artifacts table after current access, source-hash and edition-review checks, in the same transaction as audit.
POST /workspace/analysis/read returns stored bytes only after checking report ownership, payload/Markdown hashes, current matter access, source hashes and exact edition review records.
Client Markdown and extra download fields are rejected; UI downloads the server response rather than cached report text.
Generic evidence read/review routes cannot bypass report checks; report snapshots are excluded from the evidence review queue.
Snapshots survive restart and backup recovery without database schema changes; persistence is explained in the UI and data-flow guide.

validation.backup_round_trip: exact Markdown and review records preserved; restored tokens disabled; a pre-backup revocation still blocks report reads

limitations: Hash verification proves consistency with the server snapshot, not legal correctness or an independent digital signature.
Database administrators can replace bytes and recompute hashes; no protection against complete database compromise is claimed.
Snapshots have no automatic expiry and contain matter data; target-host retention and backup policy still require acceptance.
Restoring an older backup cannot recreate later access/review events; current authority must be checked before returning the deployment to service.
Real model/search configuration, Chromium browser acceptance, independent lawyer acceptance, source completeness and target deployment remain open.
